summary: Re-shipped last night's blocked branch (Skip-to-end fix, two small dashboard fixes, the first AI analysis) on top of the owner's build fix, and fixed Stats so a green run with a passing YouTube error still counts as a refresh.

Reviewing that change found statsRefreshedAt only written when nothing failed, so it would freeze while Stats stays green. Data audit 2026-11-03T16:22Z: 0 issues. findings.title: Big-money Shorts reach far more people

findings.title: Viewers leave when the structure is announced
findings.detail: 'Four levels…'/'Three clues…' right after the hook lost 24–41% of viewers in about 2 s in five recent Shorts.
